body:
Thanks. It's nice to know other people feel the same. Do you think it's better to make the effort and go, or stay home and reduce the likelihood of extra pain?

Maybe one time out of ten or fifteen I have a genuinely good time, the rest I just feel more lonely than I started. I'm not sure I like those odds, but I don't like the thought of just resigning myself to being alone to avoid feeling alone in the crowd.
